name: PayMongo

webhook.algorithm: Paymongo-Signature header, HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body, timing-safe compare, verified before any JSON parsing. The header is a comma-separated key=value list: t=<unix timestamp>, then te=<signature> for TEST-mode events and li=<signature> for LIVE-mode events — you must pick the component matching the mode of the key you hold. PARTIALLY VERIFIED: the header name, algorithm, raw-body requirement and the te/li mode split are confirmed; the exact concatenation used as the HMAC message and any recommended tolerance window are NOT published — treat the signed-string construction as needing a live

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Basic auth with the secret key as username, empty password. Prefixes sk_ (secret, server-only) and pk_ (public, client-side) are CONFIRMED; the test/live infix (sk_test_ / sk_live_) is strongly implied by the SDK example sk_test_BQokikJOvBi

fees.notes: Cards 3.125% + PHP 13.39 per transaction, exclusive of VAT. Storefront add-on PHP 349/month. Medium confidence — from a 2026 comparison page, not a fetched PayMongo rate card. Local e-wallet (GCash/Maya) rates differ and are UNKNOWN.

notes: The Philippines is a self-serve-signup market with no shipped coverage, and PayMongo is the only PH gateway with a Stripe-shaped developer experience (sk_/pk_ keys, PaymentIntents, hosted Checkout Sessions, real sandbox). It is also the practical route to GCash, which has no open direct merchant API.

SDKs: node: paymongo (community-maintained under the paymongo GitHub org); php: paymongo/paymongo-php; python: paymongo-python (PyPI, third-party). SDK quality is materially below Stripe/Razorpay — prefer raw HTTPS + explicit types in generated code.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps Xendit and HitPay in PH. PayMongo is the PH-only specialist with the best DX; Xendit wins if the merchant also sells in Indonesia.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
